emily: quick flag from onboarding: rerank smoke failing intermittentlyone vector in a batch is length 1535 vs expected 1536. happens during token rotation under load.
noah: can you paste the API reject?
emily: server log: 
```
[2026-06-01T15:10:05Z] ERROR embeddings.api: bad_request vector_dim_mismatch expected=1536 got=1535 batch=onboard-44
```
jin: that pattern screams the batching helper requeue/split bug. we've seen an off-by-one when the tail chunk is re-enqueued on auth retry.
emily: python sampleapp currently pads short vectors silently which hides the failure for customers. that made onboarding confusing.
noah: short-term: SDKs and samples should validate vectors pre-send and fail fast by default. add `strictShape=true` config in helpers so the default is explicit fail. docs can show how to opt-in to padding.
jin: agree. also improve the API 400 body so SDKs can present a clear message: {error: "vector_dim_mismatch", expected:1536, got:1535, index:7, sample_id:"onboard-44"}.
emily: any quick mitigation we can ship to onboarding today?
noah: push a tiny guard in the batching helper that runs `validateShapes(batch, expectedDim)` and returns a descriptive 400 instead of requeueing. also disable auto-pad in the python sampleapp by default.
jin: i'll push a unit test that simulates auth refresh mid-batch (force token expiry, trigger retry path) to catch the duplicate enqueue / slice math.
docs-bot: Created doc draft: "Embed shape: strictShape default and pad_on_mismatch opt-in" (internal).
devex-bot: New issue DE-1700: "embeddings: strictShape default + fix auth-requeue slice" (https://git.internal/redwood/issues/DE-1700)
emily: tested local canary with strictShape=true  showing clear 400 with expected/got/index. updating onboarding guide and sample README to call this out.
noah: follow-up: add telemetry metric `sdk.embed.invalid_dim` with tag `sample_app=true|false` so support can filter onboarding noise.
jin: will add metric + alert threshold for onboarding ramps. closing loop when PR + docs merge.
